alt: 孩子看著桌上木橋模型，順著大人指向的支架露出驚喜表情，伸手準備把裝反的木片轉正。
scene_prompt: At a kitchen table a child has struggled to assemble a small wooden bridge model. A friendly adult points directly to the one upside-down support piece, showing its correct orientation with a matching loose piece in hand. The child's suddenly wide eyes, delighted open smile and one hand lifted in realization are the focus; the other hand is just about to rotate the mistaken piece. Clearly show the simple cause of the new understanding; no magical lightbulbs, no thought bubbles. Two people, natural hands and simple readable construction.
